item.title: Colorado leaders react to U.S. attack on Iran: ‘A war of choice’
item.description: Several of Colorado’s top elected officials called for congressional intervention hours after the U.S. and Israel launched a major attack on Iran, with the state’s federal delegation reacting along party lines either supporting or decrying the military action by President Donald Trump’s administration.

item.title: CU Buffs, Deion Sanders announce offseason staff changes
item.description: Colorado and head coach Deion Sanders announced several offseason staff changes on Saturday, including making it official that Chris Marve has been promoted to the defensive coordinator position.

item.title: Bluebell fire burning near Chautauqua Park in Boulder is 75% contained
item.description: A wildfire is burning on a half acre near Boulder's Chautauqua Park, fire officials said Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Chaparral boys basketball, headlined by four impact players, eyes Class 6A state title
item.description: The Chaparral boys basketball team is determined to make their own version of the tip-in heard 'round Colorado.

item.title: Grading The Week: Lu Dort is lucky Nuggets’ Nikola Jokic didn’t rearrange his teeth
item.description: Nikola Jokic had every right to be M-V-Peeved at The Thunder's Lu Dort.

item.title: Disastrous fourth quarter dooms Buffs women’s basketball in Provo
item.description: PROVO, Utah – A disastrous fourth quarter on Saturday likely cost the Colorado women’s basketball team the fourth seed for the Big 12 tournament.

item.title: CSU Rams hold off San Jose State for seventh straight win
item.description: CSU had to hold off the Trojans in the second half but improved to 19-10 overall and 10-8 in the Mountain West Conference

item.title: Colorado Avalanche rebound in 3-1 win over Blackhawks at Ball Arena
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche defeated the Chicago Blackhawks 3-1 at Ball Arena. Gavin Brindley and Cale Makar both snapped goal-scoring droughts in the home win.

item.title: Rapids flush bad Seattle result, blank Portland Timbers 2-0 in home opener
item.description: Like the Colorado Rapids’ performance, Matt Wells’ facial expressions were night and day from a week ago.
